title: Astroscale proposes fleet of 'bodyguard' spacecraft to protect satellites from orbital attacks
caption:
Could space debris tech be the answer to orbital stalking? Astroscale is proposing a new fleet of bodyguard satellites to keep intelligence assets safe.
